name: data-lms-trigger
description: To make use of data-* attributes to load the modal, this attribute value must be set to 1, else the modal will not be triggered!

name: data-lm-transition-duration
description: Fade in/out transition or animation duration. If omitted or passing 0 as value will disable the transition.

name: data-lm-css-class
description: Pass additional css class names to the modal dialog. Multiple class names must be separated by space.

name: data-lm-auto-width
description: By default the modal has auto width, means that it will fit to content's width. If you specifically pass the value of 0, then you can set a fixed width value.

name: data-lm-width-value
description: A fixed width value. Only usable if `data-lm-auto-width` is not set or has a value of 0.

name: data-lm-width-unit
description: Any valid css unit. This can be px,vw, em, rem, etc. If left empty px will become the unit.

name: data-lm-max-width-value
description: A maximum width value. Ignored if empty or less than or equal to 0. The modal dialog's maximum width will not exceed this value and unit below.

name: data-lm-max-width-unit
description: Same as width unit. Any valid css unit is usable.

name: data-lm-min-width-value
description: A minimum width value. Can be greater than or equal to 0. The modal dialog's minimum width will be set to this value and unit below.

name: data-lm-min-width-unit
description: Same as width unit. Any valid css unit is usable.

name: data-lm-auto-height
description: By default the modal has auto height, means that it will fit to content's height. If you specifically pass the value of 0, then you can set a fixed height value.

name: data-lm-height-value
description: A fixed height value. Only usable if `data-lm-auto-height` is not set or has a value of 0.

name: data-lm-height-unit
description: Any valid css unit. This can be px,vh, em, rem, etc. If left empty px will become the unit.

name: data-lm-max-height-value
description: A maximum height value. Ignored if empty or less than or equal to 0. The modal dialog's maximum height will not exceed this value and unit below.

name: data-lm-max-height-unit
description: Same as height unit. Any valid css unit is usable.

name: data-lm-min-height-value
description: A minimum height value. Can be greater than or equal to 0. The modal dialog's minimum height will be set to this value and unit below.

name: data-lm-min-height-unit
description: Same as height unit. Any valid css unit is usable.

name: data-lm-on-show
description: A global function name, that is called right after modal is added to DOM. If the function not exist, it will be silently ignored, with a console log `Function named {funcName} could not be found!`

name: data-lm-on-before-show
description: A global function name, that is called right before modal is added to DOM. If the function not exist, it will be silently ignored, with a console log `Function named {funcName} could not be found!`

name: data-lm-on-hide
description: A global function name, that is called right after modal is removed from DOM. If the function not exist, it will be silently ignored, with a console log `Function named {funcName} could not be found!`

name: data-lm-on-before-hide
description: A global function name, that is called right before modal is removed from DOM. If the function not exist, it will be silently ignored, with a console log `Function named {funcName} could not be found!`

name: data-lm-h-enabled
description: Is header section enabled? Setting 0 will completely remove header section.

name: data-lm-h-title
description: Title text for header section.

name: data-lm-h-title-tag
description: The title tag. Normally one of the 6 heading tags are used: `h1`, `h2`, `h3`, `h4`, `h5` and `h6`. But any tag is usable.

name: data-lm-h-css-class
description: Pass one or more css class to header element. Allows you style the header element and it's contents.

name: data-lm-f-enabled
description: Enable footer section. Pass 0 to hide footer section.

name: data-lm-f-mode
description: Footer display mode. One of these 3 possible values: ['alert','confirm','custom']. In alert mode just displays a close button, in confirm mode displays an ok and close button, and finally in custom mode, display whatever you like.

name: data-lm-f-content
description: If footer mode is 'custom' and you just need to display simple text content then use this attribute to pass the footer content. But, if your custom footer contains html markup, then use the `data-lm-f-template-id` attribute below.

name: data-lm-f-template-id
description: A <template> element id to use as footer content source.As long as a <template> element with given id exists, its inner html will automatically be pulled as footer content.

name: data-lm-f-on-ok
description: A callback function name as footer ok button click handler. As long as the function exists globally, then executes the function when footer ok button is clicked.

name: data-lm-b-css-class
description: Css classes to pass to modal body element.

name: data-lm-b-content-type
description: On of the values from this list ['function', 'html', 'iframe', 'image', 'ajax', 'youtube-video', 'template']. The parameters below only relates to particular content type.

name: data-lm-b-content
description: When content type is `html` and target content is simple text that can be safely inserted as attribute value. Pass the text in here.

name: data-lm-b-template-id
description: A template element id. Applicable only when content type is `template`

name: data-lm-b-function-name
description: A global function name, when content type is `function`. If function not found, an error message will be set as modal content.

name: data-lm-b-function-args
description: Optional arguments passed to the function above. You can pass anything as string as parameter. So, JSON encoded data is also valid. Just make sure to properly encode data so that it does become valid attribute value.

name: data-lm-b-video-url
default: An youtube video or shorts url. As long as it is embeddable, it will display and be ready to play. For video and image, if you hide header and footer and set body padding to 0, you will have a full video or image in the popup! Also, in video and image mode you can pass the aspect ratio using `data-lm-b-aspect-ratio` attribute, so they can keep their original aspect ratio and scale well based on width or height.

name: data-lm-b-aspect-ratio
description: Effective for video and image content. Helps with preserving image and video aspect. For video it is usually 16/9, and shorts it's 9/16. For image, it varies, you just need to calculate it based on image width and height.

name: data-lm-b-image-url
description: For content type `image`. Pass in the image url here.
